description: This Python module provides utilities for post-processing and normalizing subtitle entries, including timestamp adjustments and text updates based on word-level comparison, with a focus on conservative merging rules.

methods.name: str apply_additional_compliance_fixes(path: str, processed_dir: str)
methods.description: Creates a copy of a subtitle file with potential post-processing corrections, saving it to a new file in the specified directory.

methods.name: List[str] _extract_words(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts alphanumeric words from text, converting them to lowercase for comparison.

methods.name: bool _should_update_text(old: str, new: str)
methods.description: Determines whether subtitle text should be updated based on differences in core words, ignoring punctuation, whitespace, and casing.

methods.name: bool _time_change_is_significant(old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: float)
methods.description: Checks if timestamp changes are at least one second in either start or end times.

methods.name: Dict conservative_merge_subtitle_update( original: Dict, proposal: Dict, )
methods.description: Merges a proposed subtitle correction into the original, applying timestamp updates only if the change is significant and text updates only if core words differ.

ctags.name: _time_change_is_significant
ctags.pattern: /^def _time_change_is_significant(old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: flo/
ctags.signature: (old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: float)
